findingDetails.title: REQ-047's both-copies clause does not hold on a routed single-target route
findingDetails.scopeProof: The gate and the fixture are in review-scope-files.txt, and the two copies were executed on the same prompts.
affectedSurfaceHints: fixture servedRun rows and the served-run test
findingDetails.claim: On a routed single-target route, the native gate serves the routed mode command for an ask that names no mode, while the Python gate serves no run row.
findingDetails.counterevidenceSought: Checked the fixture comment, which scopes the servedRun column to the deferred route, and the observed run, which reported none for the three prompts. Both show the deferred route only; neither shows a routed route for a mode-free ask, so the divergence is conditional on the compiled router.
findingDetails.alternativeExplanation: The main scenario is deferred for the named prompts, so the divergent branch may be unreachable for any prompt a reader types.
findingDetails.downgradeTrigger: If the compiled router never returns a single-target route for an ask whose mode the cue vocabulary does not name, the branch is unreachable and the finding is documentation of a latent difference.

noveltyJustification: One new P2 on the routed branch the fixture column does not exercise; the 59-REQ sweep otherwise confirmed the recorded evidence.
